The companion to [Physical Picture](../physical-picture/index.qmd). Those pages ask what an
object *is*; these ask how it is actually computed — which approximation the
code makes, which convention it stores things in, and where the equation on
paper stops matching the array in memory.

Written while doing the work, so it records the parts that no manual states.

## Yambo

GW, BSE, real-time dynamics.

::: {#l-yambo}
:::

## SIESTA

Density functional Bogoliubov–de Gennes and the localized-orbital basis.

::: {#l-siesta}
:::

## Ground state, phonons, Wannier functions

Quantum ESPRESSO, Wannier90, and what has to be right before anything else is.

::: {#l-dft}
:::

## Numerics

Methods that are not tied to one code: integration over the Brillouin zone,
iterative diagonalization, convergence, parallel decomposition.

::: {#l-numerics}
:::
